TORI AND TJ’S BIG ADVENTURES

A Dinosaur
for a Pet

It was Saturday. The sun was out.
Bean the doggy spun about.
Tori clipped his leash on tight.
“PARK DAY!” TJ yelled. “ALL RIGHT!”

1

They found the path beside the swings.
Bean sniffed at a hundred things.
Then Bean stopped short. His ears went flat.
He pulled and pulled. “Bean! What is that?”

2

The bushes shook. The leaves went CRUNCH.
Bean backed up. He had a hunch.
Out came a tail. Out came a head.
“That’s not a squirrel!” Tori said.

3

They stared at him. He stared right back.
He opened up. He let it crack:
ROAAAAR!The pigeons flew off in a crowd.
TJ shouted, “DO IT LOUD!”

4

He didn’t bite. He didn’t chase.
He licked TJ right on the face.
“He likes us!” TJ said. “Hooray!
Can we take him home to stay?”

5

They clipped the leash. They gave a tug.
He didn’t move. He gave a shrug.
Then off he went — and here’s the thing:
the kids went too, like kites on string!

6

At home they showed him Bean’s small bed.
He set down one enormous head.
The bed went POP. The stuffing flew.
Bean just watched. (He always knew.)

7

They poured his food into a bowl.
He reached for it. He missed his goal.
His arms were short. His arms were small.
So he just ate — bowl, food, and all!

8

“Bath time!” Tori said. “Hop in!”
He squeezed inside. He gave a grin.
He wagged his tail from side to side.
The water went for one last ride!

9

They tossed a ball. “Go fetch!” they cried.
He galloped off. He looked outside.
He came back proud. He came back tall.
He brought a TREE — but not the ball.

10

Then something moved outside the door.
He filled his chest. He let it pour:
ROAAAAR!The windows shook. The lamp fell down.
Mom called out, “WHAT was that sound?”

11

They looked at Dino. Dino sat.
He’d popped the bed. He’d squashed the mat.
He wasn’t bad. He wasn’t mean —
he just was not a pet like Bean.
“He needs more room,” said Tori. “See?
A dino needs to be — well — FREE.”

12

They walked him back the way they came.
They hugged his leg. They said his name.
The park was big. The park was free.
Bean barked once — like “I agree!”

13

Now every Saturday at nine
they visit Dino’s favorite pine.
Bean runs ahead. He knows the way.
And Dino roars a big HOORAY:
ROAAAAR!

14
THE END
